Vanilla JS only

No frameworks, no TypeScript, no bundler

The child CANNOT READ — all child-facing UI must use icons, audio, and visual feedback, never text-only

Touch targets minimum 64px, prefer 80px+ for child interactions

Tracing canvas must fill at least 70% of viewport width

Preserve the 4-stage flow: MEET → PICK → TRACE → CELEBRATE — do not add mode selection screens

Do not modify quinnja.png — animate the mascot using CSS transforms on its container

Keep audio.js and data.js backward-compatible when extending them

All localStorage keys prefixed with quinnjaLetters.

No emoji anywhere — use SVG or the mascot PNG

No base64-embedded assets

Match ReadyQuest visual style: Fredoka font, warm cream/peach gradients, orange primary buttons

Prefer minimal, reviewable diffs

Ask before changing localStorage key names or the letter data structure
